gen-gf-gugi-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One reads soft and rounded, its strokes like cut lengths of cord, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. And paragraphs of it settle into a gentle, ropey texture beneath Gugi, the bolder display face.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-jaldi: Approachable and brushed-on, Jaldi crowds its letters together beneath a tall x-height. But text in it moves briskly and friendly, while Gugi keeps horizontals and verticals matched in weight up top.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord, tidy and clean, under Gugi's bold, thick-thread display lettering. Paragraphs in it run smooth and unfussy, line after line down the page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mitr: Gugi's lowercase rises almost to cap height, and its stroke holds one width through every curve and corner. Gugi owns the bold display moment; Mitr keeps text friendly and contemporary.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee reads chunky and approachable, its lowercase tall and sturdy, a clean counterweight to Gugi's drafting-line headings. Gugi handles display with constant-line precision; Mukta Mahee handles the reading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mukta-malar: Gugi draws a flat, unmodulated stroke and lifts its lowercase almost to capital height. And Mukta Malar, neutral and approachable with its compressed ascenders, gives that boldness a quiet, compact partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mukta-vaani: Gugi draws like smooth wire, bold and tall in the lowercase. Mukta Vaani, high-waisted and contemporary, sits against it like a quiet, modern counterpart to all that wire boldness.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-narnoor: Gugi keeps its thickness constant around every curve, bold display lettering whose lowercase reaches toward the capitals. Narnoor, with short ascenders above big bowls, is the restrained counterpart, and that tension is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-display: Round, wiry, bold: Gugi bends its letters like wire, while Noto Sans Display fills every word with a tall middle zone. And if Gugi is made small, its bent-wire character fades fast.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-rambla: Distinctive and bold, Gugi holds a tube-like thickness through every bend of its letters. And Gugi belongs in large, brief lines, while Rambla's small letters stand nearly as tall as capitals.
